definitions.gloss: front side; front part; the front
definitions.explanation: The front-facing part or side of an object, building, body, or area. Used to specify spatial orientation.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{前側|まえがわ}に{入口|いりぐち}がある。
examples.english: The entrance is on the front side of the building.

examples.japanese: このシャツは{前側|まえがわ}にポケットが{二|ふた}つ{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: This shirt has two pockets on the front.

notes:
A compound of {前|まえ} (front) and {側|がわ} (side). Part of a set of directional compounds using {側|がわ}: {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ} (back side), {右側|みぎがわ} (right side), {左側|ひだりがわ} (left side), {片側|かたがわ} (one side).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前側|まえがわ}の{席|せき} — front seat
- {前側|まえがわ}に{回|まわ}る — to go around to the front
- {体|からだ}の{前側|まえがわ} — the front of the body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前面|ぜんめん} — front surface (more formal)
- {正面|しょうめん} — the front, directly facing
- {後|うし}ろ{側|がわ} — back side (antonym)
